title: Weekly Hours for Making Ads in AI Tools vs Outsourcing Compared
summary: No vendor publishes a typical weekly figure for AI ad tools. Log one week of scripts, re-renders and review, then compare hours per approved ad with outsourcing.
body_markdown:
## How do you measure your own weekly hours?


Log one normal week with one line per step, then count the finished ads you approved at the end of the week, not the files you generated. Your figure is the total hours divided by approved ads, which gives an hours-per-approved-ad number you can set against a quote. The table shows where each step lands in each route.


Step to log With a self-serve AI tool When you outsource


Briefing and scripting You write, preview and correct each script You brief and approve the angle


Generating and retries You, with credits spent on every re-render The provider


Captions, edits and export You The provider


Claim and caption review You check every ad The provider checks first, and you still approve the claims


Upload and campaign setup You You, or the agency if it manages your Meta campaigns


Confirm in writing which of these steps a provider's scope covers, because scopes differ. Then price the outsourced route on the same unit: a quote for the same number of finished, approved ads, with the same approval steps and delivery window. Count the hours you spend on briefing calls and approval rounds, since they are the part of the outsourced route that stays with you.


Log the hidden work separately. Re-renders after a script change, a caption check against the audio and a check on default enhancements take time even though no invoice shows them. For a fuller look at the cost side, see our[DIY versus done-for-you guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/diy-ai-video-ads-vs-done-for-you) .


## When does an AI tool still make sense?


If you ship a few ads a month and enjoy the production work, an AI tool can be the lower cash cost. HeyGen lists its Creator plan at $29 a month billed monthly with 600 credits, and Arcads starts at 8,000 credits a month on Starter, so the subscription is small next to an agency quote. The time cost stays with you, though. A steady weekly program can make the review and re-render loop most of the job, so the hours grow with every ad you approve. For a wider view of production spending, see our[video ad production cost guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/video-ad-production-cost) .


## Key takeaways


- None of the vendor pages we checked publish a typical weekly hour count for AI ad tools, so log one week of your own steps.
- Re-renders after script changes, retries and review repeat on every ad, and that is where the hours go.
- As of October 2026, HeyGen says A-Roll changes require re-rendering and consume credits, and Arcads charges for captions and translation.
- Knowlify is our top pick for the outsourced route: about 25 finished ads a week, with a person checking every ad before delivery.
- Compare hours per approved ad with an outsourced quote for the same number of ads.


## FAQ


### Is there a typical number of hours to make an ad with AI tools?


Not one that the vendor pages we checked publish. They list credits, minutes and turnaround, but none gives the time a person spends on scripts, previews, edits and approvals. Measure one normal week and divide the hours by the number of approved ads.


### What takes the most time in an AI video workflow?


The steps that repeat on every ad usually add up fastest: scene changes, retries and review. HeyGen recommends previewing speech and scenes before rendering for that reason. Give each correction its own line in your log.


### Are generation credits the only cost?


No. Your time to write, check and fix the work is a cost too, and it stays with you on a self-serve tool. Credit charges also vary by action, so check the displayed charge before each change.


### Does a done-for-you agency remove all the work?


It takes over production, but your approvals still matter. Plan to approve the offer, the claims and the product facts before a finished ad runs. Knowlify is our done-for-you route, and a person checks every ad before delivery.


### How should I compare an outsourced quote with my hours?


Ask the provider for the same number of finished, approved ads and the same approval steps. Divide your logged hours by the approved ads, and compare that with the quote per ad. Include tool credits and any agency fee on both sides.
